title: Matt LaFleur confirms Packers plan to have Micah Parsons return Week 12 vs. Rams

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Matt LaFleur confirms Packers plan to have Micah Parsons return Week 12 vs. Rams
sources.description: It was widely reported that edge rusher Micah Parsons was targeting the Week 12 game against the Rams for his return from reconstructive knee surgery.
